name: proofengine
description: Symbolic Verification Layer for Financial Code

scripts.build: npm run build -w @proofengine/core && npm run build -w @proofengine/solver-api && npm run build -w @proofengine/cli && npm run build -w @proofengine/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/core.test.js && node test/solver.test.js && node test/mcp-and-quota.test.js && node test/disasters.test.js
